input:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE students (
  roll_no  INT,
  name     VARCHAR,
  course   VARCHAR,
  centre   VARCHAR,
  marks    NUMBER(5,2),
  joined   DATE
);
INSERT INTO students VALUES
  (2401, 'Anuj',    'PGCP-BDA', 'Kharghar', 78.50, '2026-02-02'),
  (2402, 'Aarshvi', 'PGCP-BDA', 'Juhu',     88.00, '2026-02-02'),
  (2403, 'Riya',    'PGCP-AI',  'Kharghar', 91.25, '2026-02-03'),
  (2404, 'Kabir',   'PGCP-AC',  'Kharghar', 67.00, '2026-02-03'),
  (2405, 'Sana',    'PGCP-BDA', 'Kharghar', 93.75, '2026-02-04'),
  (2406, 'Omkar',   'PGCP-AI',  'Juhu',     72.50, '2026-02-04'),
  (2407, 'Meera',   'PGCP-AC',  'Juhu',     84.00, '2026-02-05'),
  (2408, 'Tejas',   'PGCP-BDA', 'Juhu',     59.25, '2026-02-05');

-- one JSON object per student
SELECT OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('roll', roll_no, 'name', name, 'marks', marks) AS student_json
FROM   students
WHERE  centre = 'Juhu'
ORDER  BY roll_no
LIMIT  2;

-- one document per course, students ordered by marks
SELECT course,
       ARRAY_AGG(OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('name', name, 'marks', marks))
         WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY marks DESC) AS toppers
FROM   students
WHERE  course = 'PGCP-AI'
GROUP  BY course;

-- name → marks lookup object for one centre
SELECT OBJECT_AGG(name, marks::VARIANT) AS marks_by_name
FROM   students
WHERE  centre = 'Kharghar';
